name: 九幽菇
evolution: 菇菇丁 → 多菇丁 Lv.36 → 九幽菇 Lv.48
description: 在古老的遗迹中发现了九幽菇的石雕，当时的洛克对九幽菇充满了崇拜，它们会在仪式上围着九幽菇唱歌，并在祭祀的指导下服用其孢子，进入幻觉，企图沟通神明，然而也存在接触它的孢子太久而神志不清的情况，等等，难道我也……
descriptionEn: Stone carvings of Jiuyougu were found in ancient ruins. The Roco of that time worshipped Jiuyougu; they would sing around it in rituals and, guided by priests, consume its spores to enter hallucinations, attempting to communicate with the gods. Yet there were also cases of losing one's mind from prolonged exposure to its spores... wait, could I also be...
